_comment: Two targets exist and only these two: `staging` (synthetic rehearsal, environmentClass
`production`). Every entry ships with projectRef/supabaseUrl = null and approved = false,
which makes the guard REFUSE that target before any client is created. Brent fills the
exact Supabase project ref (20 lowercase alphanumerics), the exact URL
(https://<projectRef>.supabase.co, no path, port, query or credentials) and flips
`approved` to true when the target is authorised. There is no flag, env var or code path
that bypasses an unapproved, null, mismatched, localhost or unknown target.
`keyEnv` names the environment variable that must carry the service-role key at runtime;
the key value itself is never committed, logged or echoed. The guard additionally
cross-checks a JWT-shaped key's embedded project ref and role against the entry.
